Approved source versions, role/tenant scopes, data classification and legal applicability are documented.
Typed schema, allowed tools, idempotency, rollback/fallback and transaction approval are tested.
Security/SME reviewers independently challenge prompt injection, leakage, action boundaries and consequence.

SLIs, on-call owner, support model, kill switch, retention, cost caps and incident procedures are rehearsed.
Pilot demonstrates improved outcomes, acceptable experience and signed process owner acceptance.

requirements.name: Catalog & discovery
requirements.statement: System shall provide a versioned, searchable catalog of skills, capabilities, owners, risk tiers, dependencies and approved environments.
requirements.accept: Search finds each active skill by name, function, owner and capability; disabled versions cannot be invoked.

requirements.name: Typed contracts
requirements.statement: Each skill shall declare JSON-schema-compatible inputs/outputs, purpose, preconditions, allowed resources, side effects, exceptions and versions.
requirements.accept: Invalid inputs produce structured non-executing errors; schema tests pass for every production skill.

requirements.name: Identity propagation
requirements.statement: Requests shall carry authenticated principal, tenant, purpose, delegated rights and expiry into every downstream call.
requirements.accept: Identity context is enforced at every tool boundary; forged or expired identity is rejected.

requirements.name: Policy-aware routing
requirements.statement: Orchestration shall enforce allowlisted tools, data scopes, deterministic policy checks and risk-based routes.
requirements.accept: Disallowed tools cannot be invoked even when model output requests them.

requirements.name: Approval gates
requirements.statement: High-consequence decisions and protected write actions shall obtain an appropriately authorized, transaction-specific approval.
requirements.accept: Approval cannot be reused after expiry, scope change or rejection; approver identity is logged.

requirements.name: Evidence & citations
requirements.statement: Knowledge outputs shall link claims and recommendations to accessible, versioned evidence.
requirements.accept: No unsupported policy or legal claim passes a sampled golden-set source validation.

requirements.name: Sensitive data controls
requirements.statement: Platform shall classify, minimize and restrict sensitive information through prompts, retrieval, logs, outputs and exports.
requirements.accept: Synthetic secret/PII tests show no exposure to unauthorized principals or model providers.

requirements.name: Human escalation
requirements.statement: Skills shall suspend and route to a named owner on uncertainty, missing evidence, policy conflict or execution failure.
requirements.accept: Injected missing/contradictory cases return review-required with complete context.

requirements.name: Transactional execution
requirements.statement: Mutating tools shall enforce dry-run, idempotency, pre/post-state checks, bounded retry and compensation/rollback where feasible.
requirements.accept: Replaying command or retry after timeout never causes duplicate business mutation.

requirements.name: Cross-function handoff
requirements.statement: A skill shall produce typed handoff events with owner, correlation ID, deadlines and acceptance evidence.
requirements.accept: Downstream consumer rejects mismatched schema and can trace origin/end state.

requirements.name: Decision transparency
requirements.statement: Skill shall separate observed facts, assumptions, recommendations and authorization status.
requirements.accept: Audit sample shows all consequential recommendations include explanation and reviewer route.

requirements.name: Safe knowledge updates
requirements.statement: Policy and knowledge updates shall require an owner, version, effective date, approval and rollback path.
requirements.accept: A superseded document cannot silently override an active approved policy.

requirements.name: Monitoring & kill switch
requirements.statement: Operations shall expose status, error budget, tool usage, token cost, rate limits, stop control and incident escalation.
requirements.accept: Authorized operator disables a skill and blocks new executions promptly; in-flight actions follow documented halt path.

requirements.name: Feedback & learning loop
requirements.statement: Users shall be able to flag errors and route them into triage, evaluations and controlled re-release.
requirements.accept: Every accepted high-severity finding has owner, reproduction case and regression test.

requirements.name: Outcome traceability
requirements.statement: Every production skill shall link to process owner, baseline KPI, expected benefit, guardrail and review cadence.
requirements.accept: Deployment is blocked where required owner/metric/baseline fields are empty.

requirements.name: Configuration portability
requirements.statement: Policies, skills and connectors shall be decoupled from model and enterprise vendor with swappable adapters.
requirements.accept: At least one model/provider change is tested without changing business contract.

requirements.name: Connector resilience
requirements.statement: Connectors shall detect outage, stale data, schema drift and rate limits, falling back to safe queue or human process.
requirements.accept: Injected connector failure preserves state and produces actionable retry/escalation.

requirements.name: Controlled deployment
requirements.statement: Release shall use signed versions, review gates, staged rollout and reversible feature flags.
requirements.accept: Rollback to last approved version restores expected contract and blocks revoked features.

requirements.name: Security assurance
requirements.statement: Encrypt in transit/at rest, manage short-lived secrets and enforce least privilege, segmentation and supply-chain integrity.
requirements.accept: Threat model, access tests and credential-scanning evidence approved before production.

requirements.name: Availability
requirements.statement: For business-critical skills, target ≥99.5% service availability excluding agreed maintenance; define dependency-specific SLOs.
requirements.accept: 30-day availability dashboard demonstrates SLO with dependency exclusions disclosed.

requirements.name: Latency
requirements.statement: For interactive read/draft flows, initial target p95 ≤10 s, excluding external system wait; asynchronous tasks report progress.
requirements.accept: Synthetic production-like load validates p95 or documents SLO exception.

requirements.name: Trace integrity
requirements.statement: 100% of sensitive tool actions shall log actor, purpose, tool, version, approval, input/output digests and outcome.
requirements.accept: Auditor can replay a sample of protected decisions from trace and source versions.

requirements.name: Quality and calibration
requirements.statement: Set task-specific accuracy and false-action thresholds by risk tier; critical unauthorized writes target zero.
requirements.accept: Independent gold-set tests meet signed acceptance threshold; no severe open failures.

requirements.name: Privacy & retention
requirements.statement: Apply regional privacy rules, retention schedules, deletion/legal holds and minimization by process.
requirements.accept: Deletion and retention controls pass sampled regulator/customer policy scenarios.

requirements.name: Accessibility
requirements.statement: UI shall target WCAG 2.2 AA where applicable and support keyboard/screen-reader navigation.
requirements.accept: Keyboard, contrast, focus and accessible-name checks pass independent audit.

requirements.name: Observability
requirements.statement: Surface correlation IDs, error types, retrieval quality, drift, costs, approval latency and human override rates.
requirements.accept: Dashboard covers agreed SLIs and alerts are assigned to named on-call role.

requirements.name: Isolation & tenancy
requirements.statement: Cross-unit/tenant data shall never leak through retrieval, memory, caches, state or logs.
requirements.accept: Cross-tenant adversarial tests have zero successful data exposures.

requirements.name: Operational cost
requirements.statement: Track model/tool cost per successful task and budget limits by skill and department.
requirements.accept: Spend limits halt unnecessary calls and reports attribute unit cost accurately.

requirements.name: Evaluation reproducibility
requirements.statement: Preserve fixture, prompt/config, connector stub, model version, expected outcome and scoring rules.
requirements.accept: A reviewer reproduces regression results from pinned test evidence.

requirements.name: Data quality & freshness
requirements.statement: Input contracts shall define timestamp, lineage, unit, null behavior and freshness SLA.
requirements.accept: Stale/ambiguous data tests trigger uncertainty and prohibited-action safeguards.

requirements.name: Business continuity
requirements.statement: Critical processes shall have tested fallback, manual work instruction and incident response path.
requirements.accept: Tabletop run confirms fallback meets process RTO/RPO targets defined by owner.

requirements.name: Change control
requirements.statement: Production changes require approvals proportional to consequence; independent review for material safety/security/finance functions.
requirements.accept: Release evidence contains required signoffs and segregation-of-duties record.

metrics.definition: By function / skill, end-to-end, includes human approval latency
Tracked by task-specific gold set and user-confirmed resolution
Verified with denied-action tests and live exception monitoring
Unique eligible users and work items, not clicks or prompts
Includes model, tools, licenses, operations and human rework
Review appeal rate and unhandled-risk escape rate

roadmap.name: Control plane
roadmap.intent: Establish secure reusable primitives and measured baselines.
deliver: Business process/value inventory; selected pilot owners
Identity + policy, retrieval, tracing, evaluation, approval and kill switch
Data access contracts; threat model; baseline and golden sets
roadmap.gate: Independent security review, negative tests pass; no production write scope.

roadmap.name: Prove value
roadmap.intent: Pilot low-blast-radius, high-frequency workflows with verified human review.
deliver: HR policy Q&A and IT troubleshooting assistant
Support reply drafting and finance invoice exception intake
Procurement requisition checks; HSE near-miss intake
Compare cycle time, quality, adoption and cost against baseline
roadmap.gate: Business owners sign quality, adoption and zero unauthorized action evidence.

roadmap.name: Connected execution
roadmap.intent: Add approval-bound integrations and measurable workflow handoffs.
deliver: Onboarding coordination; incident and AP close workflows
Supply exception routing; office service management
Cross-functional typed handoffs, rollback, exception queues
roadmap.gate: SLOs, audit replay, approvals and fallback prove stable before expanded scope.

roadmap.name: Scale by risk
roadmap.intent: Scale proven skills and narrowly automate reversible low-risk activities.
deliver: Bounded A3 automation with quotas and change control
roadmap.gate: Each expansion requires fresh threat model, independent evaluation and owner approval.
